occupations.cat: Street and related sales and service workers

n.story:
Your role is undergoing a fundamental shift as physical paper distribution is increasingly replaced by digital proximity marketing. While the core task of handing out flyers is being automated through digital kiosks or targeted mobile advertisements, your value is pivoting toward 'human-centric' local navigation and brand representation. In areas where physical presence still matters—such as tourism hubs or local festivals—you become more of a local guide than a simple distributor.

AI tools now provide you with hyper-optimized routes and real-time data on where foot traffic is highest, ensuring you are in the right place at the right time. However, the 'human touch' remains your primary asset. Your ability to read a person's mood, offer a genuine smile, and provide a helpful local recommendation is something a digital screen cannot do. You are evolving from a manual laborer into a mobile brand ambassador and local information specialist.
auto: Route planning and geographic area mapping
amp: Real-time response to foot traffic patterns
n.adv: Lean into the 'ambassador' aspect of your role; your ability to provide a friendly, human interaction is your only defense against total digital replacement.
